# Session Close — The End Is Always the Same

_Applies when: wrapping any change — the fixed closing sequence, in this order._

Work ends the same way every time — the ordered ritual that ties the workflow rules together; this rule only sequences them, the mechanics live where they always did.

## The close sequence

1. **Green gate + DoD pass** — `30-quality` (web: `31-quality-web`). Not done until it does.
2. **Commit discipline** — Conventional Commits, a `feat/…`|`fix/…` branch, one PR; never push to `main` without an explicit go-ahead; no `--no-verify` (`20-workflow`). **A push whose CI result nobody read is not a finished step** — bind the read to the pushed SHA, never to the newest run (`skill:verify`).
3. **Doc discipline** — `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated, ADR added if architecture changed, story moved to `done/` (`20-workflow`).
4. **Write memory** — record the task's decisions, constraints and gotchas before you stop; symmetric on both targets — closing with stale memory is not closing (`23-memory-discipline`).
5. **Flag, don't auto-release.** Keep `[Unreleased]` current and commit freely; a **tagged release** costs money (publish + bundle + seed) and is go-ahead-gated. When work is shippable, **flag** it and let the human decide when to tag — never tag reflexively (`20-workflow`).
6. **Reflect upstream — the safety net, not the channel.** Anything about agent-core itself this session exposed and did not file at the moment of the finding: file it now, never fix it inline. Channel, commands and the evidence bar live once, in `50-agent-core`.

Skip none of the six. The end is a ritual, not a judgement call.
